facts.text: West Bay Club sits on the widest stretch of Grace Bay Beach.
facts.excerpt: Nestled on the widest stretch of Grace Bay Beach, one of the most celebrated beaches in the world, our intimate oceanfront resort

facts.text: West Bay Club is an intimate oceanfront resort.
facts.excerpt: our intimate oceanfront resort

facts.text: Contemporary Caribbean style defines every studio and suite.
facts.excerpt: Contemporary Caribbean style defines every studio and suite at West Bay Club, where spacious layouts, private terraces, and thoughtful luxury touches come together

facts.text: Accommodations feature oceanfront living spaces, spa-inspired bathrooms and fully equipped kitchens or kitchenettes.
facts.excerpt: featuring oceanfront living spaces, spa-inspired bathrooms, and fully equipped kitchens or kitchenettes

facts.text: The Premier Oceanfront Three Bedroom Suite offers 3,800 square feet on the top floor, with two oceanfront balconies and a third balcony with panoramic island views.
facts.excerpt: the Premier Oceanfront Three Bedroom Suite offers 3,800 square feet of exceptional living on the top floor, with unobstructed views from two oceanfront balconies and a third balcony with panoramic island views

facts.text: The Oceanfront Luxury One Bedroom Suite has a bathroom with an oversized soaking tub, separate shower and double vanity.
facts.excerpt: complemented by a luxurious bathroom with an oversized soaking tub, separate shower, and double vanity

facts.text: The Oceanfront Luxury Four Bedroom Suite is designed for larger groups and families, with a large private terrace overlooking Grace Bay.
facts.excerpt: the Oceanfront Luxury Four Bedroom Suite is thoughtfully designed for larger groups and families. The oceanfront living room, dining area, and kitchen flow seamlessly to a large private terrace overlooking Grace Bay

facts.text: The resort is aimed at families seeking adventure and couples looking to unwind.
facts.excerpt: perfect for families seeking adventure and couples looking to unwind

facts.text: A pre-arrival concierge can arrange excursions and activities before guests arrive, and personal concierges book excursions on site.
facts.excerpt: Our pre-arrival concierge will be happy to make excursion or activity arrangements prior to your arrival, and our expert team of personal concierges will be thrilled to discuss, recommend and book any excursion

facts.text: Excursions range from short kayak tours to full-day trips to uninhabited islands.
facts.excerpt: From short kayak tours to full-day excursions to uninhabited islands, we have a variety of options certain to please.

facts.text: The Deluxe Half-Day Reef Snorkel goes by luxury catamaran to the Turks and Caicos Barrier Reef, with an island picnic lunch on a deserted beach.
facts.excerpt: Step aboard our luxury catamaran to explore the Turks and Caicos Barrier Reef, home to some of the best snorkeling in the world, where you will set sail for a relaxing afternoon on a deserted island beach paradise

facts.text: A Saxophone Sunset Sail features a live local saxophonist on board a sailing catamaran.
facts.excerpt: The only thing better than a TCI sunset is one with our live local Saxophonist on-board a luxury sailing catamaran.

facts.text: The fitness center has strength and cardio equipment, including free weights, treadmills and yoga mats.
facts.excerpt: Our fitness center features a variety of strength and cardio equipment

facts.text: The property sits on a vast and quiet stretch of Grace Bay Beach, at a remove from the resort district crowds.
facts.excerpt: The family-friendly property sits on a vast and quiet stretch of Grace Bay Beach in Turks and Caicos, at a safe remove from the swarms of vacationers in the resort district.

facts.text: The resort offers a Kids' Club.
facts.excerpt: It offers a Kids' Club, one-, two-, three-, and four-bedroom suites (all equipped with creature comforts like kitchens, washers, and dryers) and a spa.
